Ahmad Shah Abdali 2. Genghis Khan 3. Nadir Shah 4. Timur Code : (a) 1, 2, 3, 4 (b) 4, 3, 2, 1 (c) 2, 4, 3, 1 (d) 2, 4, 1, 3 Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2002 Ans. (c) The correct sequence of the foreign invaders is Genghis Khan, Timur, Nadir Shah and Ahmad Shah Abdali. Genghis Khan attacked during the reign of Iltutmish (1211-1236), Timur invaded during the reign of Nasiruddin Mahmud in 1398. Nadir Shah invaded during the reign of Muhammad Shah in 1739 and the year of the invasion of Ahmad Shah Abdali was 1748-69 A.D. 8. Which of the following statements are correct? 1. Ahmad Shah Abdali fought the third battle of Panipat. 2. Babur established the Delhi Sultanate. 3. Shah Jahan fought the war of succession. 4. Jahangir was a lover of beauty and nature. Code : (a) 1, 2 and 3 are correct Indian History General Studies B–307 (b) 1 and 3 are correct (c) 1 and 4 are correct (d) 1, 2, 3 and 4 are correct U.P.P.S.C (GIC) 2010 Ans. (c) The third battle of Panipat was fought between Ahmad Shah Abdali and Marathas in 1761. Qutbuddin Aibak was the ﬁ rst ruler of the Delhi Sultanate and also the founder of the Slave dynasty. Shah Jahan did not ﬁ ght the war of succession while it was fought among his sons (Shah Shuja, Dara Shukoh, and Aurangzeb) and Jahangir was a lover of beauty and nature. 9. Match the following events with their respective years: A. Massacres in Delhi by Nadir Shah 1. 1556 B. First battle of Panipat was 2. 1526 fought between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi C. Second battle of Panipat was 3. 1761 fought between Hemu and Akbar D. Third battle of Panipat was fought 4. 1739 between Ahmad Shah Abdali and Marathas Code : A B C D (a) 1 4 3 2 (b) 3 1 4 2 (c) 4 2 1 3 (d) 1 3 2 4 M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 1994 Ans. (c) The battle of Karnal (1739) was fought between the forces of Nadir Shah, an Iranian adventurer and Muhammad Shah, the Mughal emperor of India, at Karnal, north of Delhi in which Mughals suﬀ ered a decisive defeat. Nadir Shah massacred the populace. The ﬁ rst battle of Panipat was fought between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi on 21 April, 1526 in which Babur was victorious and laid the foundation of the Mughal empire. The second battle of Panipat was fought between Hemu and Akbar on 5 November, 1556 in which Hemu was defeated. The third battle of Panipat was fought between Ahmad Shah Abdali and Marathas on 14 January 1761 in which Marathas were badly defeated. 10. Hem Chandra Vikramaditya is famous in Indian history as – (a) Puran Mal (b) Maldev (c) Rana Sanga (d) Hemu Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2013 Ans. (d) Hemu was also known as Hem Chandra Vikramaditya. He was an emperor of North India during the 16th century, a period when the Mughal and Afghans were ﬁ ghting for power in the region. He was born in a poor, humble Brahmin family. Hemu rose to become chief of the army and Prime Minister to Adil Shah Suri of the Suri dynasty. He fought Afghan rebels across North India from Punjab to Bengal and the Mughal forces of Akbar and Humayun in Agra and Delhi, winning 22 consecutive battles out of 24. Hemu won the Battle against Targi Begh and assuming the title of Vikramaditya that had been earlier adopted by many Hindu kings since Vedic times. He was defeated in the second battle of Panipat and was beheaded by Bairam Khan, the commander of Akbar’s army. 11. ‘The last Sun of Indian glory’ has been used for – (a) Shivaji (b) Prithviraj (c) Rana Pratap (d) Hemu U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2016 Ans. (b) According to the Historian B.N. Luniya Prithviraj Chauhan was the last sun of Indian glory. 12. Which among the following source throw light on the history of Parmara Dynasty? (a) Navsahsank Charit of Padmagupta (b) Prabandha Cintamani of Merutunga (c) Udaipur Prashasti (d) All of the above M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2019 Ans. (d) The Parmara Dynasty was an Indian dynasty that ruled Malwa and surrounding areas in west-central India between 9th and 14th centuries. The medieval bardic literature classiﬁ es them among the Agnivashi Rajputs dynasties. Navasahsank Charit of Padmagupta, Prabandha Chintamani of Merutunga and Udaipur Prashasti all throw light on the Parmara Dynasty. 13. Match the following : A. Third Battle of Panipat 1. 1192 B. (a) Sultan Shamsuddin Shah (b) Sultan Qutbuddin (c) Sultan Sikandar (d) Sultan Zainul Abidin (e) None of the above/More than one of the above 64th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2018 Ans. Which of the following pair (battle during the Mughal and Maratha Period and its year) is correctly matched? (a) Battle of Chausa - 1538 A.D. (b) Battle of Kanauj - 1539 A.D. (c) Battle of Haldighati - 1576 A.D. (d) Battle of Khajwa - 1657 A.D. (e) Battle of Khed - 1699 A.D. Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (Pre) 2016 Ans. (c) Battle of Haldighati was fought between Maharana Pratap and Akbar's forces led by Man Singh of Amber in 1576. Battle of Chausa was fought between Humayun and Shershah in June, 1539. Battle of Kannauj or Bilgram was fought between Humayun and Shershah in May, 1540. Battle of Khed was fought between Shahu and Tarabai for the Maratha throne in 1707 AD. Select the correct chronological order of the following battles from the codes given : A. Third Battle of Panipat 1. 1601 A.D. B. Battle of Haldighati 2. 1761 A.D. C. Second Battle of Tarain 3. 1576 A.D. D. Battle of Asirgarh 4. 1192 A.D. Code : A B C D (a) 1 2 3 4 (b) 4 3 2 1 (c) 2 3 4 1 (d) 3 4 2 1 U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1998 Ans. (c) The third battle of Panipat was fought between Afghans and Marathas in 1761 in which Afghans were led by Ahmad Shah Abdali and Marathas were headed by Sadashivrao Bhau. Marathas were badly defeated in this battle. The battle of Haldighati was fought between Akbar and Maharana Pratap in 1576 in which Maharana Pratap was defeated. In the second battle of Tarain (1192), Muhammad Ghori defeated Prithviraj Chauhan. The battle of Asirgarh was fought between Miran Bahadur and Akbar in 1601. The battle resulted in the defeat of Miran Bahadur and the possession of Asirgarh by the Mughals. 21. Which of the following is not correctly matched ? (d) The battle of Balkh took place during the reign of Shah Jahan in 1646. Rest of the options are correctly matched. 22. (a) Battle of Sarnal (Gujarat) was held during the Gujarat campaign of Akbar in 1572 AD in which Akbar defeated Ibrahim Mirza. Shershah Suri defeated Humayun in the battle of Bilgram in 1540 AD. Aurangzeb defeated the forces of Dara Shukoh in the Battle of Dharmat in 1658 AD. Battle of Jajau was fought in 1707 AD between Bahadur Shah I and Muhammad Azam Shah for the successor of Aurangzeb after his death. B–310 General Studies Indian History 23.
